name: clinic-cyber
description: Hệ thống quản lý Nha khoa Nụ Cười Việt — backend (Express) + frontend (Next.js) + database (PostgreSQL)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm start --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix frontend"
